## KD-246 Rendered-title reference correction

Mine, 6 November 2026: “Approve the single title correction”. I approved the
Appendix F expected browser title changing from “F. `tecvol` | Debug80 Docs”
to “F. tecvol | Debug80 Docs”. The renderer resolves inline Markdown rather
than displaying code delimiters. Exactly that title value and its representation
explanation may change. Reader text, the other thirty-eight titles, H1s, sidebar
labels, pagers, links, fragments, literal fences, inputs and execution limits
remain unchanged. The checker algorithm remains exact equality and no generic
backtick transformation is authorised.

Retain SITE02 as failed under its original reading. Apply the approved single
correction, run all existing controls plus the focused title/navigation/fence
cases, then seal and independently review the exact new packet before a fresh
allocated actual render. This decision grants no retry of the old seal, site
publication or broader reference amendment. The source mechanism and complete
impact census remain in [the reviewed proposal](reviews/book-title-reference.md).
authority: Explicit approval conveyed by P3; source decision inspected
scope: Single Appendix F title and representation explanation; refreshed synthetic controls and sealed independent review only; no actual invocation or publication allocated
